## Ma Hooffield

[![Ma Hooffield approaching the McColt gate beside Twilight Sparkle and Fluttershy](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2020/7/18/1169488.png)](https://twibooru.org/1169488)

*Show still from* My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic *(Hasbro/DHX production), depicting the suspicious “apology cake.”*

Ma Hooffield is the stubborn, outspoken **earth-pony matriarch of the farming Hooffields**, who feud with the construction-minded McColts in the Smokey Mountains. Remember her as the pumpkin-throwing family leader who ultimately learns to put the valley’s animals ahead of winning an ancient argument.

**Appearance:** Tan-brown coat; large, pale-cream curls in her mane and tail; blue eyes, prominent front teeth, a pumpkin cutie mark, and a blue work vest over a pale shirt with a red neckerchief.

**Name and voice:** “Ma Hooffield” is **spoken in the episode and listed in its credits**, not merely a fan-given name. Ellen Kennedy voices her. The Hooffield/McColt family names parody the historic Hatfield–McCoy feud. See the [season-five on-screen credit transcription](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_five).

**Appearances:** Her principal speaking role is *The Hooffields and McColts* (S5E23, 2015). She also appears in the crowd at Twilight’s coronation in *The Last Problem* (S9E26) and in a photograph in *Baby Flurry Heart’s Heartfelt Scrapbook*, episode 3; the [character catalogue](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Elders) also documents her Gameloft mobile-game incarnation. These are appearances within G4-related works, not evidence of a secret identity.

**Fan artwork:** [Chub-Wub’s illustrated ensemble of expressive-eyebrow ponies](https://twibooru.org/3399395) includes Ma Hooffield; the post identifies the artist and links its original source.

## Important moments

All four scenes are from *The Hooffields and McColts* (S5E23): [officially published full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HIWOovJb8XU). **Scene timestamps unavailable** (none independently verified); dialogue can be checked against the [episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Hooffields_and_McColts).

1. **“Pumpkinin’ our neighbors” — S5E23, *The Hooffields and McColts*.** Ma introduces herself while directing a pumpkin barrage against the McColts, immediately showing how entrenched the feud is.
2. **The false apology cake — S5E23, *The Hooffields and McColts*.** She smuggles Hooffield fighters inside the cake Twilight believes is a peace offering, turning a possible reconciliation into another battle.
3. **Apologizing to the animals — S5E23, *The Hooffields and McColts*.** Fluttershy reveals how the feud destroyed the valley’s habitat; Ma apologizes and admits that both families were wrong.
4. **Choosing a truce — S5E23, *The Hooffields and McColts*.** When she and Big Daddy nearly restart their argument over who conceded first, the animals prompt Ma to offer a real truce.
